title: Which one fails?
examObjective: Applying correct syntax to write DataWeave transformations to coerce, format, order, and filter data
prompt: Three of these return a value. **One fails when it runs.** Which one?

options:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
"x" match { case is Number -> "n" case is String -> "s" }

%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
true match { case is Number -> "n" case is String -> "s" }

%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[1, "a", null] map ($ match { case is Number -> "num" case is Null -> "null" else -> "other" })

%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
true match { case is Number -> "n" else -> "other" }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
true match { case is Number -> "n" else -> "other" }

explanation.approach: A `match` without `else` compiles, but if no case accepts the value at run time it throws. Add an `else` whenever the input is not fully under your control.

snippets.label: The one that fails
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
true match { case is Number -> "n" case is String -> "s" }
snippets.note: None of the match cases matched.

snippets.label: Type cases with an else
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[1, "a", null] map ($ match { case is Number -> "num" case is Null -> "null" else -> "other" })
